chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 269 — A Dao-Character that Stops Time; The Goblins’ Final Stand Begins
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning’s party escapes through a void gate using a one-use time-distortion scroll. The goblins realize this is their last chance for survival — and their battle-cry shakes Heaven and Earth.
og_title: Time Freezes, the Warship Dashes Through — Desolate Era Chapter 269
og_description: Shaoyan Nong activates a scroll that slows time to a crawl, letting the party reach the final hall. But the goblins aren’t retreating — they’re ready to die for their world.
twitter_title: The Scroll of Stillness — Desolate Era Ch. 269
twitter_description: A single Dao-Character bends time itself. The warship escapes, but now the goblins fight not for freedom — but for survival.

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivator whose physical body was destroyed during the tribulation; their Nascent Soul or Primal survives, allowing them to live on, but with a finite lifespan and periodic tribulations that grow ever stronger.
A temporary spatial portal created by a key or token that can teleport an object or group across vast distances or into a pocket dimension.
A powerful Primordial Fiendgod allied with Shaoyan Nong, able to take a massive serpentine form with nine heads. He serves as a diversion and escapes laughing after the party breaches the blockade.
A Loose Immortal leader of the goblin forces in the Immortal Mansion World. He delivers the rallying speech that transforms the battle into a fight for civilizational survival.

A pocket realm or demiplane created by an ancient Celestial Immortal, containing its own ecosystem, goblins, and treasures. Fully controlling its central hall grants dominion over the entire pocket dimension.
